title: Platform lifts, stairway chair lifts and vertical reciprocating conveyors (VRCs).
officialText:
Platform lifts, stairway chair
lifts and VRCs shall be inspected and tested at intervals not exceeding one year. Inspections and tests shall be performed
in accordance with Table N1.
